about: Copies as renderCopy draws them (test/desk-sheet-doc.test.js), and what Copy put on the clipboard for each before E37 moved it onto the document model (the old copyForWord in sheet-word.js, run on 2026-11-06). Copy must still produce exactly this, save two intended changes since: the key terms box is wrapped in a ruled one-cell table (E57, 2026-11-06), and a link’s address is written as a valid URI, so the mailto link’s quotes are percent-encoded (DK3-9, 2026-11-07).
